en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muhammad Al Khazzaz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who publicises upon us<sup>asws</sup> of our<sup>asws</sup> Hadeeth, so he would be at the status of the one who denied us<sup>asws</sup> of our<sup>asws</sup> rights’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said to Moallah Bin Khunays: ‘The publiciser of our<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> Ahadeeth is like the denier of it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Muhammad al-Khazzaz from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Whoever publicizes our (confidential) Hadith is like one who has denied our rights.’
The Imam (a.s.) had also said to al-Mu’alla ibn khunays, ‘One who publicizes our Hadith is like one who rejects them.’”
